ABOUT

ABOUT US

Astra Multimarket Corporation is a SEC-accredited direct importer and authorized distributor of brand-new trucks, heavy equipment, and cranes from globally recognized brands such as FAW, ISUZU, DONGFENG, SHANTUI, and PALFINGER. With our headquarters in EDSA, Quezon City and branches across the country, we serve a wide range of clients—from SMEs to large corporations and government agencies. Committed to authenticity, quality, and dependable after-sales support, Astra is your trusted partner in driving your business forward.

MISSION

We are committed in Astra to provide excellent customer service both internally, through adaptation of best corporate practices, and externally by providing products of finest quality, reliability, and at a reasonable price that allows Astra to grow together with its partners and customers.

VISION

Astra moves to become the leader and most reliable source of brand new commercial vehicles and machineries in the Philippines by exceeding customer expectations not only in product delivery, but also in providing professional truck and equipment solutions.
